# datadog_status_pages (Data Source)

Use this data source to list existing Datadog status pages, for discovery or import. An empty result is not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datadog_status_pages" "acme_status_pages" {
  name = "Acme Status"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter the results to pages with this exact name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status_pages` (List of Object) The list of matching status pages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_pages))

<a id="nestedatt--status_pages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_pages`

Read-Only:

- `domain_prefix` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `page_url` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `visualization_type` (String)
